title: SkillsFuture Credits for Overseas Courses Not Available through Singapore Training Providers
what_it_is: SkillsFuture Credits for Overseas Courses Not Available through Singapore Training Providers

sections.label: SkillsFuture Credit course directory overseas courses
sections.summary: The SkillsFuture Credit course directory has about 17,000 skills-based courses, but overseas courses are largely excluded because providers cannot be audited.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: As at 30 September, the SkillsFuture Credit course directory has about 17,000 skills-based courses covering over 50 areas of training.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: However, by and large, we do not include courses conducted overseas in the SkillsFuture Credit course directory because their lack of presence here means that we are unable to audit or check these training providers for quality or to prevent any possible misuse.

sections.label: Massive Open Online Courses included
sections.summary: Massive Open Online Courses from overseas institutions offered through companies like Udemy and Coursera are included under SkillsFuture Credit.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: In addition to that, we have also included Massive Open Online Courses designed by overseas institutions which are offered through reputable overseas-based companies like Udemy and Coursera, under the SkillsFuture Credit.

sections.label: Highlighting courses for consideration
sections.summary: Members may highlight industry-relevant programmes not conducted in Singapore to SSG, and the directory includes almost 2,000 online courses, about 12%.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: I want to reiterate, if Mr Tan comes across any specific training programme that is currently not conducted in Singapore, not in the 17,000 SkillsFuture Credit course directory, but deemed as industry-relevant, we welcome him to highlight it to us, to SSG, for consideration and evaluation.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: I want to again assure the Member that the diversity of courses reflected in the 17,000 SkillsFuture Credit course directory includes almost 2,000 online courses: that means about 12%.

sections.label: Reimbursement suggestion and IES collaboration
sections.summary: A reimbursement-based examination suggestion was thanked, SSG will look at the case, and work with IES is possible for professional qualifications.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: So, maybe, one way is to let them take the examination on the courses and then they would submit based on a reimbursement basis.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: I want to thank Er Dr Lee Bee Wah for the suggestion and please allow SSG to look at the case in point.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: The Member cited a few areas which seem to be professional qualifications required, for example, by engineers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: This is an area where we can work with the Institution of Engineers Singapore (IES).

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Please allow me to reiterate that the SkillsFuture movement is really not just about SkillsFuture Credit.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: We have a slew of SkillsFuture initiatives, even benefiting, targeting and focusing on the needs of the PMEs and also C-level executives.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: One example is the SkillsFuture Leadership Development Initiative.
